Here at the Animal Hospital of Mt. Pocono, we know that your pet deserves the best care, and we're here for you when positive results matter most.  Dr. Valese, as the owner and sole veterinarian of the Animal Hospital of Mt. Pocono, has been helping pets live longer, healthier lives since 1983. Dr. Valese, and all of our highly trained staff, will provide you peace of mind and a listening ear.  Call us today!  (570) 839-8116
    Located in the heart of the beautiful Pocono Mountains, the Animal Hospital of Mt. Pocono serves the communities of greater Mt Pocono, Blakeslee, Cresco, Gouldsboro, Henryville, Long Pond, Swiftwater, Tannersville, Tobyhanna, East Stroudsburg, Stroudsburg, and surrounding areas of Monroe, Pike, Lackawanna, Luzerne, and Wayne counties of Pennsylvania.
